newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.

text.p: Police seized on Thursday two tons of cocaine bound for Europe and the United States at a roadblock in Cali, Colombia's second largest city, officials said.

The drugs, found in a pickup truck, were wrapped in 60 bundles weighing 77 pounds (35 kg) each, police said. The shipment was to be exported through the main Pacific coast port of Buenaventura, police added.

The shipment is thought to have belonged to the so-called Central Valle del Cauca cartel, one of the many small drug mobs that mushroomed across the country after the virtual breakup of the Cali cartel following the arrest of its leaders, the Rodriguez Orejuela brothers, in 1995.
